“Creating Slides using LaTeX BEAMER”

   
Webinar on “Creating presentation slides using LaTeX BEAMER” held on 2/1/2021 from 3 pm to 4.30 pm. Welcome speech given by Sudhakar N, Assistant prof and In charge Head, Department of mathematics Sudhakar N Briefed about the speaker Dr.Mahesh Lohith K S Total number of participants were 130 About the webinar Briefed about the supporting documents required to install the Latex. 1.Introduction to L A TEX Documentation About L A TEX,   Features of L A TEX, L A TEX vs Word,     Versions of L A TEX and Editors Installation and File Format, L A TEX Document Classes, L A TEX 2ε Beamer 2.General structure, Beamer Coding,Frames, Blocks, Columns, title page,  lists, figures, themes, theme colours, Matrix, Equations, tables, merging etc., Vote of thanks given by Sudhakar N, Asst prof and Incharge Head, Department of mathematics Feedback Survey is as follows
